messages:
maria_ops: Heads up — provisioning failures in us-central1. Several gpu-attach jobs stuck, node iowait > 90%. Seeing janitor sweep stuck on stale TTL entries. Investigating now.

aj_devinfra: On it. Which process are you seeing? `scratch-ttl-sweeper` or `janitor-cleaner`?

maria_ops: `scratch-sweep` (daemon) PID 2345 in D state. Logs show repeated EIO when unlinking /scratch/tmp/* and huge metadata read ops. NVMe pending IO climbing.

kevin_sre: Observed k8s attach queue spiking — ~120 pending pods, scheduler latency ~45s. This is blocking GPU provisioning. Can we throttle sweep concurrency to reduce IO pressure?

aj_devinfra: Yes. Plan: reduce JANITOR_CONCURRENCY from 16 -> 2 for us-central1 and bump SCRUB_RETRY_BACKOFF_MS to 5000. Will canary on 3 nodes first.

janitor-bot: auto: rollout started for config 'janitor-concurrency-reduce' in us-central1 — nodes updated 0/3.

maria_ops: Any quick mitigation to relieve the attach backlog? Can we evict the sweeper from GPU hosts temporarily?

kevin_sre: Evicting daemonset from GPU hosts via cordon/evict is risky. Alternative: set node-label `scratch-sweeper-disabled=true` and have the DaemonSet honors that label. Faster to patch config.

aj_devinfra: Patch pushed to canary. `kubectl get pods -l app=scratch-sweep -n infra -o wide` shows canary on node-gpu-03/04/05. Monitoring IO now.

maria_ops: Quick logs snippet: 
```
2026-04-21T15:07:03Z scratch-sweep[2345]: unlink(/scratch/tmp/abc123): EIO
2026-04-21T15:07:03Z scratch-sweep[2345]: retrying delete (attempt=3)\n```
Also attaching `iostat -x 1 5` showed avg await 320ms on nvme0n1.

aj_devinfra: After canary config, QPS on scrub reads dropped ~60%. GPU attach backlog down from ~120 to 27 in 12m. :thumbsup:

lisa_pm: FYI two customers hit attach failures earlier and filed SR-2341. We should track in postmortem and include timeline + customer impact.

maria_ops: Opening incident now and collecting timeline + SMART logs. Will include `nvme smart-log` dumps and `dmesg` extracts.

kevin_sre: Follow-up plan: keep reduced concurrency and increase sweep window. Medium-term: move large-file deletes to a low-priority background GC that uses retry/backoff with jitter, and respect per-device IO caps. Also schedule firmware health probes on suspect hosts.

janitor-bot: auto: incident created INC-2026-0421 (scratch TTL sweep causing IO spikes).

aj_devinfra: Monitoring for 1h. If stable, promote region-wide config change. ETA ~45m. Revert plan in case of regressions ready.

maria_ops: Thanks everyone — will add timeline to the incident and ping when we promote.
